What are your favorite local coffee brands for espresso beans?

I grew up in eastern mass but left a decade ago for Chicago, and I’m back for the month. I want to get a few bags of espresso or dark roast coffee beans that are local to western/central mass, and also eastern mass. I’m hoping to stock up so I can compare to what they got in Chicago :D Anyone have any recommendations? Having a hard time finding good brands online. When I lived here I was a Dunks beans kind of girl 😂 9

There are a ton of choices, so here's a Central/Western MA list of a few that I have bought from and would buy from again. These are in no particular order either. https://www.armeno.com/ (Northborough) https://www.monsoonroastery.com/ (Springfield) (They sell their coffee in Crowlers which is pretty neat) https://acousticjava.com/ (Worcester) https://www.brillacoffee.com/ (Holden/Northborough) https://treehousebrew.com/coffee (Charlton) https://smokestackroasters.square.site/ (Lunenburg) https://www.indigocoffee.com/ (Northampton)

Oh my GOD I could kiss you thank you so much!!! I’m super pumped to have some espresso from back home 😊

And from what I'm seeing they all ship around the country, so as long as they're in business, you'll stay caffeinated. If I were to choose some favorites, I'd say Armeno, Monsoon, & Brilla.

A lot of these placesa will do custom blends, grinds if your order 5lbs or more. We have have had a custom blend made by indigo for almost 15 years and whenevert I sip it (daily) I look at it impressed.

+1 for Armeno, it's become my exclusive go-to

https://www.goodasgold.com/ Good as gold Coffee roasters based out of Worcester. We use them at the diner I work at and they have amazing service.

Gracenote is the gold standard. Broadsheet, Little Wolf, George Howell are the other go-to eastern MA roasters.

Shelburne Falls has some good roasts, mostly in the pioneer valley.

https://union-coffee-roaster.square.site/ from Shirley

Fazenda, Equal Exchange, Remnant, One Ocean Coffee, and I heard Polcaris is good but haven’t tried

THANK YOU

My absolute favorite espresso bean comes from Esselon Coffee out in Hadley, MA. They ship. https://www.esselon.com/
